uses.quote: Unauthorised use of Gen AI includes but is not limited to the use of a Gen AI tool to generate any form of submitted work that a learner submits without proper acknowledgment of that tool’s use in its generation.

Presenting text, digital work (e.g. computer code or programs), video recordings or images copied with only minor changes from sources such as the internet, the output of GenAI, books, journals or any other media, without due acknowledgement;

The presenting or making use of fictitious, altered or misrepresented data, evidence, references, citations or experimental results and includes the use of GenAI created content or output that is fabricated or
the use of AI for any placement activity must be in accordance with both this policy and approved by the student’s supervisor or equivalent in the relevant placement setting.
